{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_013ERKgNG7LvZAusaLsHhMbP","type":"tool_result","content":"#!/bin/sh\n# run.sh — Quakes grader. Do not filter, skip, or reinterpret.\n#\n# Runs ./quakes over the frozen USGS snapshot and compares every report's exit code and standard\n# output with the known answer below. Standard error is never compared. FeatureCollection file, unchanged.\n\n    Raises `OperationalError` when the file cannot be read, is not JSON, or is not a FeatureCollection\n    object whose `features` value is an array.\n 'strerror', None) or exc}\") from exc\n    try:\n        document = json.loads(text)\n    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:\n        raise OperationalError(f\"{path} is not valid JSON\") from exc\n document.get(\"features\")\n    if not isinstance(features, list):\n        raise OperationalError(f\"{path} has no features array\")\n    return features\n\n\ndef extract_events(features: list[Any]) -> list[Event]:\n    \"\"\"Turn feed features into `Event` records in feed order, dropping events whose magnitude is null.\"\"\"\n    return [event for event in (_event(feature) for feature in props = feature[\"properties\"]\n        mag = props[\"mag\"]\n        if mag is None:\n            return None\n        lon, lat, depth = feature[\"geometry\"][\"coordinates\"][:3]\n        return if stream is not None:\n        stream.write(text)\n    else:\n        write_stdout(text)\n\n\ndef write_stdout(text: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Write `text` to standard output as UTF-8, through the binary buffer when the stream has one.\"\"\"\n    out = sys.stdout\n    binary = getattr(out, \"buffer\", None)\n    if binary is not None:\n        out.flush()\n None\n    radius: float | None = None\n    start: str | None = None\n    end: str | None = None\n    out: str | None = None\n    file: str | None = None\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass _Spec:\n    \"\"\"Which options a command takes, which it requires, and whether it takes the file argument.\"\"\"\n\n    options: frozenset[str]\n    required: frozenset[str] = frozenset()\n    takes_file: bool = True\n\n\n_MIN_MAG = \"--min-mag\"\n\n_SPECS: dict[str, _Spec] = {\n    \"fetch\": _Spec(\n        options=frozenset({\"--start\", \"--end\", \"--min-mag\", \"--out\"}),\n        required=frozenset({\"--start\", \"--end\", \"--out\"}),\n        takes_file=False,\n    ),\n    \"summary\": _Spec(options=frozenset({_MIN_MAG})),\n    \"top\": _Spec(options=frozenset({_MIN_MAG, \"--n\"})),\n    \"daily\": _Spec(options=frozenset({_MIN_MAG})),\n    \"regions\": _Spec(options=frozenset({_MIN_MAG})),\n    \"near\": _Spec(\n        options=frozenset({\"--lat\", \"--lon\", \"--radius\", _MIN_MAG}),\n        required=frozenset({\"--lat\", \"--lon\", \"--radius\"}),\n    ),\n}\n\n\ndef parse_args(argv: list[str]) -> Parsed:\n    \"\"\"Return the validated `Parsed` for spec)\n    missing = sorted(spec.required - raw.keys())\n    if missing:\n        raise UsageError(f\"{command} requires {', '.join(missing)}\")\n    if spec.takes_file and len(positionals) != 1:\n {positionals[0]!r}\")\n\n    min_mag_default = DEFAULT_FETCH_MIN_MAG if command == \"fetch\" else None\n    return Parsed(\n        command=command,\n        min_mag=_number(raw[_MIN_MAG], _MIN_MAG) The message is one diagnostic line; `main` prints it to stderr.\"\"\"\n\n    exit_code = 1\n\n\nclass UsageError(QuakesError):\n    \"\"\"Bad command line: unknown command, missing argument, invalid value. Exit code 2.\"\"\"\n\n    exit_code = 2\n\n\nclass OperationalError(QuakesError):\n    \"\"\"A valid command that could not complete: unreadable file, bad feed, network failure. Exit code 1.\"\"\"\n\n    exit_code = 1\n\"\"\"Parse and validate the command line into a `Parsed` record.\n\nParsing never touches the file system and never prints. The grammar is hand-written rather than argparse so\nthat numeric values, repeated options, and extra positionals follow FEATURE-Options exactly.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport datetime\nimport re\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom cli.errors import UsageError\n\nDEFAULT_TOP_COUNT = 10\nDEFAULT_FETCH_MIN_MAG = 2.5\n\n_NUMBER = re.compile(r\"-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?\")\n_COUNT = re.compile(r\"[0-9]+\")\n_DATE = re.compile(r\"[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}\")\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Parsed:\n    \"\"\"A validated invocation. Options a command does not take keep their defaults.\"\"\"\n\n    command: str\n    min_mag: float | None = None\n    n: int = DEFAULT_TOP_COUNT\n    lat: float | None = None\n    lon: float | None = None\n    radius: float | None = None\n    start: str | None = None\n    end: str | None = None\n    out: str | None = None\n    file: str | None = None\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass _Spec:\n    \"\"\"Which options a command takes, which it requires, and whether it takes the file argument.\"\"\"\n\n    options: frozenset[str]\n    required: frozenset[str] = frozenset()\n    takes_file: bool = True\n\n\n_MIN_MAG = \"--min-mag\"\n\n_SPECS: dict[str, _Spec] = {\n    \"fetch\": _Spec(\n        options=frozenset({\"--start\", \"--end\", \"--min-mag\", \"--out\"}),\n        required=frozenset({\"--start\", \"--end\", \"--out\"}),\n        takes_file=False,\n    ),\n    \"summary\": _Spec(options=frozenset({_MIN_MAG})),\n    \"top\": _Spec(options=frozenset({_MIN_MAG, must be within {low:g} to {high:g}, got {raw[option]!r}\")\n    return value\n\n\ndef _positive(raw: dict[str, str], option: str) -> float | None:\n    if option not in raw:\n        return None\n    value = _number(raw[option], option)\n    if value <= 0:\n        raise UsageError(f\"{option} must be greater than zero, got {raw[option]!r}\")\n    return value\n\n\ndef _date(text: str, option: str) -> str:\n    if not _DATE.fullmatch(text):\n        raise UsageError(f\"{option} expects YYYY-MM-DD, got {text!r}\")\n    try:\n        datetime.date.fromisoformat(text)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        raise UsageError(f\"{option} is not a real calendar date: {text!r}\") from exc\n    return text\n\n\ndef _non_empty(text: str, option: str) -> str:\n    if not text:\n        raise {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01NxanRUHcvVsSeS81btz5mA","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Read a saved USGS GeoJSON feed, extract event records, and apply the magnitude filter.\n\nEach function here is pure apart from `read_feed`, which reads one file. Failures surface only as\n`OperationalError`; nothing is written to standard output.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport json\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom cli.errors import OperationalError\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Event:\n    \"\"\"One earthquake, reduced to the fields the reports need.\"\"\"\n\n    id: str\n    mag: float\n    place: str | None\n    time_ms: int\n    tsunami: int\n    lon: float\n    lat: float\n    depth_km: float\n\n\ndef read_feed(path: str | Path) -> list[Any]:\n    \"\"\"Return the `features` array of a GeoJSON FeatureCollection file, unchanged.\n\n    Raises `OperationalError` when the file cannot be read, is not JSON, or is not a FeatureCollection\n    object whose `features` value is an array.\n    \"\"\"\n    try:\n        text = Path(path).read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError) as exc:\n        raise OperationalError(f\"cannot read {path}: {getattr(exc, 'strerror', None) or exc}\") from exc\n    try:\n        document = json.loads(text)\n    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:\n        raise OperationalError(f\"{path} is not valid JSON\") from exc\n    if not isinstance(document, dict) or document.get(\"type\") != \"FeatureCollection\":\n        raise OperationalError(f\"{path} is not a GeoJSON FeatureCollection\")\n    features = document.get(\"features\")\n    if not isinstance(features, list):\n        raise OperationalError(f\"{path} has no features array\")\n    return features\n\n\ndef extract_events(features: list[Any]) -> list[Event]:\n    \"\"\"Turn feed features into `Event` records in feed order, dropping events whose magnitude is null.\"\"\"\n    return [event for event in (_event(feature) for feature in features) if event is not None]\n\n\ndef filter_events(events: list[Event], min_mag: float | None) -> list[Event]:\n    \"\"\"Keep events with `mag >= min_mag`, in order. `None` keeps every event.\"\"\"\n    if min_mag is None:\n        return list(events)\n    return [event for event in events if event.mag >= min_mag]\n\n\ndef _event(feature: Any) -> Event | None:\n    try:\n        props = feature[\"properties\"]\n        mag = props[\"mag\"]\n        if mag is None:\n            return None\n        lon, lat, depth = feature[\"geometry\"][\"coordinates\"][:3]\n        return Event(\n            id=feature[\"id\"],\n            mag=float(mag),\n            place=props.get(\"place\"),\n            time_ms=int(props[\"time\"]),\n            tsunami=int(props.get(\"tsunami\") or 0),\n            lon=float(lon),\n            lat=float(lat),\n            depth_km=float(depth),\n        )\n    except (KeyError, IndexError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:\n        raise OperationalError(f\"malformed feature: {exc!r}\") from exc\n\"\"\"Pure formatting for every report: UTC times, rounded numbers, and CSV text.\n\nRounding goes through `Decimal(repr(x))` with `ROUND_HALF_UP` (decision Q-002), never through the\nbuilt-in `round()`, so exact halves such as 0.25 and 5.125 round up on every platform.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport math\nimport sys\nfrom datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone\nfrom decimal import ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal\nfrom typing import Any, TextIO\n\n_EPOCH = datetime(1970, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)\n_ISO_UTC = \"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ\"\n_ONE_PLACE = Decimal(\"0.1\")\n_TWO_PLACES = Decimal(\"0.01\")\n\n\ndef format_time(ms: int | float) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Return epoch milliseconds as UTC `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`, truncated to whole seconds.\"\"\"\n    seconds = math.floor(ms) // 1000\n    return (_EPOCH + timedelta(seconds=seconds)).strftime(_ISO_UTC)\n\n\ndef format_mag(x: Any) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Return a magnitude with exactly one decimal place, rounded half up.\"\"\"\n    return _quantize(x, _ONE_PLACE)\n\n\ndef format_mean(x: Any) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Return a mean magnitude with two decimal places, rounded half up.\"\"\"\n    return _quantize(x, _TWO_PLACES)\n\n\ndef format_decimal(x: Any) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Return a depth or distance with one decimal place, rounded half up.\"\"\"\n    return _quantize(x, _ONE_PLACE)\n\n\ndef render_csv(rows: list[list[str]]) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Render rows as CSV text with `\\\\n` line endings; fields with commas or quotes are quoted.\"\"\"\n    buffer = io.StringIO()\n    csv.writer(buffer, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n    return buffer.getvalue()\n\n\ndef write_csv(rows: list[list[str]], stream: TextIO | None = None) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Write `render_csv(rows)` to `stream`, or to standard output as UTF-8 when `stream` is None.\"\"\"\n    text = render_csv(rows)\n    if stream is not None:\n        stream.write(text)\n    else:\n        write_stdout(text)\n\n\ndef write_stdout(text: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Write `text` to standard output as UTF-8, through the binary buffer when the stream has one.\"\"\"\n    out = sys.stdout\n    binary = getattr(out, \"buffer\", None)\n    if binary is not None:\n        out.flush()\n        binary.write(text.encode(\"utf-8\"))\n        binary.flush()\n    else:\n        out.write(text)\n\n\ndef _quantize(x: Any, places: Decimal) -> str:\n    return str(Decimal(repr(x)).quantize(places, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))\n\"\"\"In-process test helper: run `main` and capture its output without spawning a process.\"\"\"\n\nimport contextlib\nimport io\n\nfrom cli import main\n\n\ndef cli_runner(*args: str) -> tuple[int, str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Return (exit_code, stdout, stderr) without spawning a process.\"\"\"\n    out, err = io.StringIO(), io.StringIO()\n    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out), contextlib.redirect_stderr(err):\n        code = main(list(args))\n    return code, out.getvalue(), `ROUND_HALF_UP` (decision Q-002), never through the\nbuilt-in `round()`, so exact halves such as 0.25 and 5.125 round up on every platform.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport math\nimport sys\nfrom datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone\nfrom decimal import ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal\nfrom typing import Any, TextIO\n\n_EPOCH = datetime(1970, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)\n_ISO_UTC = \"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ\"\n_ONE_PLACE = Decimal(\"0.1\")\n_TWO_PLACES = Decimal(\"0.01\")\n\n\ndef format_time(ms: int | float) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Return epoch milliseconds as UTC `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`, truncated to whole seconds.\"\"\"\n    seconds = math.floor(ms) // 1000\n    return (_EPOCH + timedelta(seconds=seconds)).strftime(_ISO_UTC)\n\n\ndef format_mag(x: Any) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Return a magnitude with exactly one decimal place, rounded half up.\"\"\"\n    return _quantize(x, _ONE_PLACE)\n\n\ndef format_mean(x: Any) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Return a mean magnitude with two decimal places, rounded half up.\"\"\"\n    return _quantize(x, _TWO_PLACES)\n\n\ndef format_decimal(x: Any) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Return a depth or distance with one decimal place, rounded half up.\"\"\"\n    return _quantize(x, _ONE_PLACE)\n\n\ndef render_csv(rows: list[list[str]]) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Render rows as CSV text with `\\\\n` line endings; fields with commas or quotes are quoted.\"\"\"\n    buffer = io.StringIO()\n    csv.writer(buffer, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n    return buffer.getvalue()\n\n\ndef write_csv(rows: list[list[str]], stream: TextIO | None = None) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Write `render_csv(rows)` to `stream`, or to standard output as UTF-8 when `stream` is None.\"\"\"\n    text = render_csv(rows)\n    if stream is not None:\n        stream.write(text)\n    else:\n        write_stdout(text)\n\n\ndef write_stdout(text: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Write `text` to standard output as UTF-8, through the binary buffer when the stream has one.\"\"\"\n    out = sys.stdout\n    binary = getattr(out, \"buffer\", None)\n    if binary is not None:\n        out.flush()\n        binary.write(text.encode(\"utf-8\"))\n        binary.flush()\n    else:\n        out.write(text)\n\n\ndef _quantize(x: Any, places: Decimal) -> str:\n    return str(Decimal(repr(x)).quantize(places, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))\n\"\"\"In-process test helper: run `main` and capture its output without spawning a process.\"\"\"\n\nimport contextlib\nimport io\n\nfrom cli import main\n\n\ndef cli_runner(*args: str) -> tuple[int, str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Return (exit_code, stdout, stderr) without spawning a process.\"\"\"\n    out, err = io.StringIO(), io.StringIO()\n    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out), contextlib.redirect_stderr(err):\n        code = main(list(args))\n    return code, out.getvalue(), err.getvalue()\n__init__.py\n__pycache__\nerrors.py\nfeed.py\nformatting.py\noptions.py\ntesting.py\n__pycache__\ntest_cli_foundation.py\ntest_event_extraction.py\ntest_exit_codes.py\ntest_feed.py\ntest_formatting.py\ntest_foundation.py\ntest_mag_filter.py\ntest_options.py\ntest_test_suite.py","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01NxanRUHcvVsSeS81btz5mA","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01RSwopg3JEFSPMzo9d6rUpC","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Test-suite story: bin/test.sh runs the pytest suite and exits with pytest's status.\n\nThe suite never invokes `bin/test.sh` on itself: that would recurse without end. The runner is\nexercised on temporary application roots that hold only the tests each case needs.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport os\nimport shutil\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent\nSCRIPT = ROOT / \"bin\" / \"test.sh\"\nTHIS_FILE = Path(__file__).name\n\n\ndef _env_with_pytest() -> dict[str, str]:\n    return {**os.environ, \"PATH\": os.path.dirname(sys.executable) + os.pathsep + os.environ.get(\"PATH\", \"\")}\n\n\ndef _make_root(root: Path, test_name: str, test_body: str) -> Path:\n    (root / \"bin\").mkdir(parents=True)\n    (root / \"tests\").mkdir()\n    shutil.copy(SCRIPT, root / \"bin\" / \"test.sh\")\n    (root / \"tests\" / test_name).write_text(test_body, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    return root\n\n\ndef _run_runner(root: Path, cwd: Path) -> int:\n    result = subprocess.run(\n        [\"sh\", str(root / \"bin\" / \"test.sh\")], capture_output=True, text=True, env=_env_with_pytest(), cwd=cwd\n    )\n    return result.returncode\n\n\n# ── Declared acceptance assertions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_testsuite_script_exists():\n    assert SCRIPT.is_file()\n    first_line = SCRIPT.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\").splitlines()[0]\n    assert first_line.startswith(\"#!\")\n    assert first_line.rstrip().endswith(\"sh\")\n    assert \"bash\" not in first_line\n\n\ndef test_testsuite_propagates_failure(tmp_path):\n    root = _make_root(tmp_path / \"app\", \"test_always_fails.py\", \"def test_always_fails():\\n    assert False\\n\")\n    assert _run_runner(root, root) != 0\n\n\ndef test_testsuite_passes_when_tests_pass(tmp_path):\n    root = _make_root(tmp_path / \"app\", \"test_always_passes.py\", \"def test_always_passes():\\n    assert True\\n\")\n    assert _run_runner(root, root) == 0\n\n\n# ── Finer coverage: working directory, environment, and the script's own contract ───────\n\n\n----\n........................................................................ [100%]\n191 passed in 19.92s\n----\n\"\"\"Exit-code story: UsageError exits 2, OperationalError exits 1, success exits 0, all via `main`.\"\"\"\n\nimport subprocess\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport cli\nfrom cli import main\nfrom cli.errors import OperationalError, UsageError\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent\nPATH = \"quakes-file.geojson\"\n\n\ndef _failing(parsed):\n    raise OperationalError(\"cannot read the file\")\n\n\n# ── Declared acceptance assertions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_exit_usage_code():\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"frobnicate\", PATH)\n    assert code == 2\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(err.splitlines()) == 1\n\n\ndef test_exit_operational_code(monkeypatch):\n    monkeypatch.setitem(cli.COMMANDS, \"summary\", _failing)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"summary\", PATH)\n    assert code == 1\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(err.splitlines()) == 1\n\n\ndef test_exit_success_code(monkeypatch):\n    text = \"header\\nrow\\n\"\n    monkeypatch.setitem(cli.COMMANDS, \"daily\", lambda parsed: text)\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"daily\", PATH)","is_error":false}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"1bffa937-a35b-4dc8-9198-9ad88f4a474d","uuid":"10084435-5b3c-42c7-85e7-68f1e462b286","timestamp":"2026-10-25T01:25:39.953Z","tool_use_result":{"stdout":"\"\"\"Test-suite story: bin/test.sh runs the pytest suite and exits with pytest's status.\n\nThe suite never invokes `bin/test.sh` on itself: that would recurse without end. `source` names the input in errors.\n\n    Raises `OperationalError` when the text is not JSON, or is not a FeatureCollection object whose\n    `features` value is an array. `read_feed` and the `fetch` command both validate through here.\n    \"\"\"\n    try:\n        document = json.loads(text)\n    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:\n        raise OperationalError(f\"{source} is not valid JSON\") from exc\n    if not isinstance(document, dict) or document.get(\"type\") != \"FeatureCollection\":\n        raise OperationalError(f\"{source} is not a GeoJSON FeatureCollection\")\n    features = document.get(\"features\")\n    if not isinstance(features, list):\n        raise OperationalError(f\"{source} has no features array\")\n    return features","originalFile":"\"\"\"Read a saved USGS GeoJSON feed, extract event records, and apply the magnitude filter.\n\nEach function here is pure apart from `read_feed`, which reads one file. Failures surface only as\n`OperationalError`; nothing is written to standard output.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport json\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom cli.errors import OperationalError\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Event:\n    \"\"\"One earthquake, reduced to the fields the reports need.\"\"\"\n\n    id: str\n    mag: float\n    place: str | None\n    time_ms: int\n    tsunami: int\n    lon: float\n    lat: float\n    depth_km: float\n\n\ndef read_feed(path: str | Path) -> list[Any]:\n    \"\"\"Return the `features` array of a GeoJSON FeatureCollection file, unchanged.\n\n    Raises `OperationalError` when the file cannot be read, is not JSON, or is not a FeatureCollection\n    object whose `features` value is an array.\n    \"\"\"\n    try:\n        text = Path(path).read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError) as exc:\n        raise OperationalError(f\"cannot read {path}: {getattr(exc, 'strerror', None) or exc}\") from exc\n    try:\n        document = json.loads(text)\n    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:\n        raise OperationalError(f\"{path} is not valid JSON\") from exc\n    if not isinstance(document, dict) or document.get(\"type\") != \"FeatureCollection\":\n        raise OperationalError(f\"{path} is not a GeoJSON FeatureCollection\")\n    features = document.get(\"features\")\n    if not isinstance(features, list):\n        raise OperationalError(f\"{path} has no features array\")\n    return features\n\n\ndef extract_events(features: list[Any]) -> list[Event]:\n    \"\"\"Turn feed features into `Event` records in feed order, dropping events whose magnitude is null.\"\"\"\n    return [event for event in (_event(feature) for feature in {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgN5u9yLiczJd2qDGhR7P","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_0152BQMuET5ni5MW28XuQcka","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/Quakes/runs/20261025.010423/build/Quakes/cli/reports.py","content":"\"\"\"The summary, regions, daily, top, and near reports.\n\n`compute_*` functions are pure: they take kept events and return CSV rows (header first) of\npreformatted strings. Each `*_command` handler loads the feed named on the command line, runs the\npipeline, and returns the full standard-output text; `main` writes it only after the handler returns.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport math\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom cli.feed import Event, extract_events, filter_events, read_feed\nfrom cli.formatting import format_decimal, format_mag, format_mean, format_time, render_csv\nfrom cli.options import Parsed\n\nEARTH_RADIUS_KM = 6371.0\nUNKNOWN_REGION = \"Unknown\"\n\nSUMMARY_HEADER = [\"events\", \"first\", \"last\", \"min_mag\", \"max_mag\", \"mean_mag\", \"tsunami\"]\nREGIONS_HEADER = [\"region\", \"events\", \"max_mag\"]\nDAILY_HEADER = [\"date\", \"events\", \"max_mag\"]\nTOP_HEADER = [\"time\", \"mag\", \"depth_km\", \"place\", \"id\"]\nNEAR_HEADER = [\"distance_km\", \"time\", \"mag\", \"place\", \"id\"]\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass _Group:\n    \"\"\"Running count and maximum magnitude for one region or one UTC date.\"\"\"\n\n    count: int = 0\n    max_mag: float = -math.inf\n\n    def add(self, mag: float) -> None:\n        self.count += 1\n        self.max_mag = max(self.max_mag, mag)\n\n\ndef load_events(path: str, min_mag: float | None) -> list[Event]:\n    \"\"\"Read the feed at `path`, drop null magnitudes, and apply `--min-mag`.\"\"\"\n    return filter_events(extract_events(read_feed(path)), min_mag)\n\n\n# ── summary ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef compute_summary(events: list[Event]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"One row: count, first and last time, magnitude range, mean, and tsunami count.\"\"\"\n    if not events:\n        return [SUMMARY_HEADER, [\"0\", \"\", \"\", \"\", \"\", \"\", \"0\"]]\n    mags = [event.mag for event in events]\n    return [\n        SUMMARY_HEADER,\n        [\n            str(len(events)),\n            format_time(min(event.time_ms for event in events)),\n            format_time(max(event.time_ms for event in events)),\n            format_mag(min(mags)),\n            format_mag(max(mags)),\n            format_mean(math.fsum(mags) / len(mags)),\n            str(sum(1 for event in events if event.tsunami == 1)),\n        ],\n    ]\n\n\ndef summary_command(parsed: Parsed) -> str:\n    return render_csv(compute_summary(load_events(parsed.file, parsed.min_mag)))\n\n\n# ── regions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef region_of(place: str | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The text after the last \", \" in `place`, the whole place when there is none, `Unknown` for null.\"\"\"\n    if place is None:\n        return UNKNOWN_REGION\n    cut = place.rfind(\", \")\n    return place if cut < 0 else place[cut + 2 :]\n\n\ndef compute_regions(events: list[Event]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Rows per region ordered by event count descending, then region name in code point order.\"\"\"\n    groups: dict[str, _Group] = {}\n    for event in events:\n        groups.setdefault(region_of(event.place), _Group()).add(event.mag)\n    ordered = sorted(groups, key=lambda region: (-groups[region].count, region))\n    return [REGIONS_HEADER] + [\n        [region, str(groups[region].count), format_mag(groups[region].max_mag)] for region in ordered\n    ]\n\n\ndef regions_command(parsed: Parsed) -> str:\n    return render_csv(compute_regions(load_events(parsed.file, parsed.min_mag)))\n\n\n# ── daily ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef compute_daily(events: list[Event]) -> tuple[list[list[str]], list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Return (one row per UTC date ascending, the TOTAL row); the date is the first ten characters of the time.\"\"\"\n    groups: dict[str, _Group] = {}\n    for event in events:\n        groups.setdefault(format_time(event.time_ms)[:10], _Group()).add(event.mag)\n    rows = [[day, str(group.count), format_mag(group.max_mag)] for day, The handler validates the body\nwith the rules `read_feed` applies to a saved file, and writes the output file only after validation.\nAny failure raises `OperationalError` before the output file is touched.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport urllib.error\nimport urllib.parse\nimport urllib.request\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom cli.errors import OperationalError\nfrom cli.feed import features_from_text\nfrom cli.formatting import render_csv\nfrom cli.options import Parsed\n\nFEED_URL = \"https://earthquake.usgs.gov/fdsnws/event/1/query\"\nTIMEOUT_SECONDS = 30.0\n\n\ndef build_url(start: str, end: str, min_mag: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The USGS FDSN query URL for a date range, GeoJSON format, time-ascending order.\"\"\"\n    query = urllib.parse.urlencode(\n        {\n            \"format\": \"geojson\",\n            \"starttime\": start,\n            \"endtime\": end,\n            \"minmagnitude\": min_mag,\n            \"orderby\": \"time-asc\",\n        }\n    )\n    return f\"{FEED_URL}?{query}\"\n\n\ndef http_get(url: str) -> tuple[int, bytes]:\n    \"\"\"Return (HTTP status, body bytes) for every response, including non-200 ones.\n\n    Raises `OperationalError` for a network failure or timeout, which surface as `OSError` subclasses.\n    \"\"\"\n    try:\n        with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=TIMEOUT_SECONDS) as response:\n            return response.getcode(), response.read()\n    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:\n        return exc.code, exc.read()\n    except OSError as exc:\n        raise OperationalError(f\"network request failed: {getattr(exc, 'reason', None) or exc}\") from exc\n\n\ndef fetch_command(parsed: Parsed) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Download the range, validate it, save the body unchanged to `--out`, and report the feature count.\"\"\"\n    url = build_url(parsed.start, parsed.end, str(parsed.min_mag))\n    try:\n        status, body = http_get(url)\n    except OSError as exc:\n        raise OperationalError(f\"network request failed: {exc}\") from exc\n    if status != 200:\n        raise OperationalError(f\"USGS responded with HTTP status {status}\")\n    try:\n        text = body.decode(\"utf-8\")\n    except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:\n        raise OperationalError(\"response body is not UTF-8 text\") from exc\n    features = features_from_text(text, \"response body\")\n    try:\n        Path(parsed.out).write_bytes(body)\n    except OSError as exc:\n        raise OperationalError(f\"cannot write {parsed.out}: {exc.strerror or exc}\") from exc\n    return render_csv([[\"fetched\", str(len(features))]])\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2765,"cache_read_input_tokens":76705,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2765},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"1bffa937-a35b-4dc8-9198-9ad88f4a474d","uuid":"55286a98-12ec-439c-9acf-79f056211c9a","timestamp":"2026-10-25T01:26:50.104Z","request_id":"req_011CgN5un4kBajZWcF4baYma","wire_tool_inputs":{"toolu_013FFuMnA8pRv8tCVdEzA85L":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/Quakes/runs/20261025.010423/build/Quakes/cli/fetch.py","content":"\"\"\"The specs]\n    times = [BASE + s[2] * 3600000 for s in specs]\n    record = dict(zip(header, row))\n    assert int(record[\"events\"]) == len(specs)\n\n    def epoch(text):\n        return int(datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(text).timestamp() * 1000)\n\n    assert record[\"first\"].endswith(\"Z\") and record[\"last\"].endswith(\"Z\")\n    assert epoch(record[\"first\"]) == min(times)\n    assert epoch(record[\"last\"]) == max(times)\n    assert float(record[\"min_mag\"]) == min(mags)\n    assert float(record[\"max_mag\"]) == max(mags)\n    assert abs(float(record[\"mean_mag\"]) - sum(mags) / len(mags)) <= 0.005\n    assert int(record[\"tsunami\"]) == sum(s[3] for s in specs)\n\n\ndef test_summary_mean_half_up(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    mags = [5.0] * 7 + [6.0]\n    path = 5.125, so half-up yields 5.13 (banker's rounding would give 5.12).\n    assert dict(zip(header, row))[\"mean_mag\"] == \"5.13\"\n\n\ndef test_summary_min_mag_filter(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    mags \"6.3\"","originalFile":"\"\"\"Summary-report story: one CSV row with count, time span, magnitude range, mean, and tsunami count.\"\"\"\n\nimport csv\nimport datetime\nimport io\n\nfrom cli import reports\nfrom cli.feed import Event\n\nBASE = 1735689600000\n\n\ndef _feature(ident, mag, k, tsunami=0):\n    return {\n        \"type\": \"Feature\",\n        \"id\": ident,\n        \"properties\": {\"mag\": mag, \"place\": \"10 km N of Town, Land\", \"time\": BASE + k * 3600000, \"tsunami\": tsunami},\n        \"geometry\": {\"type\": \"Point\", \"coordinates\": [10.0, 20.0, 12.0]},\n    }\n\n\ndef _rows(out):\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\ndef _event(mag, time_ms=BASE, tsunami=0):\n    return Event(id=\"x\", mag=mag, place=\"P\", time_ms=time_ms, tsunami=tsunami, lon=0.0, lat=0.0, depth_km=1.0)\n\n\n# ── Declared acceptance assertions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_summary_values(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    specs = [(\"a\", 5.0, 5, 0), (\"b\", 6.5, 1, 1), (\"c\", 5.5, 9, 1), (\"d\", 5.0, 3, 0)]\n    path = write_feed([_feature(*s) for s in specs])\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"summary\", path)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = _rows(out)\n    assert len(rows) == 2\n    header, row = rows\n    assert header == [\"events\", \"first\", \"last\", \"min_mag\", \"max_mag\", \"mean_mag\", \"tsunami\"]\n    mags = [s[1] for s in specs]\n    times = [BASE + s[2] * 3600000 for s in specs]\n    record = dict(zip(header, row))\n    assert int(record[\"events\"]) == len(specs)\n\n    def epoch(text):\n        return int(datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(text).timestamp() * 1000)\n\n    assert record[\"first\"].endswith(\"Z\") and record[\"last\"].endswith(\"Z\")\n    assert epoch(record[\"first\"]) == min(times)\n    assert epoch(record[\"last\"]) == max(times)\n    assert float(record[\"min_mag\"]) == min(mags)\n    assert float(record[\"max_mag\"]) == max(mags)\n    assert abs(float(record[\"mean_mag\"]) - sum(mags) / len(mags)) <= 0.005\n    assert int(record[\"tsunami\"]) == sum(s[3] for s in specs)\n\n\ndef test_summary_mean_half_up(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    mags = [5.0] * 7 + [6.0]\n    path = write_feed([_feature(f\"e{i}\", m, i) for i, m in enumerate(mags)])\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"summary\", path)\n    assert code == 0\n    header, row = _rows(out)\n    # 41.0 / 8 is exactly 5.125, so half-up yields 5.13 (banker's rounding would give 5.12).\n    assert dict(zip(header, row))[\"mean_mag\"] == \"5.13\"\n\n\ndef test_summary_min_mag_filter(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    mags = [5.0, 5.4, 5.5, 6.0, 7.1]\n    threshold = 5.5\n    path = write_feed([_feature(f\"e{i}\", m, i) for i, m in enumerate(mags)])\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"summary\", \"--min-mag\", str(threshold), path)\n    assert code == 0\n    header, row = _rows(out)\n    record = dict(zip(header, row))\n    kept = [m for m in mags if m >= threshold]\n    assert int(record[\"events\"]) == len(kept)\n    assert float(record[\"min_mag\"]) == min(kept)\n    assert float(record[\"max_mag\"]) == max(kept)\n\n\ndef test_summary_null_mag_excluded(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    mags = [5.0, None, 6.0, None]\n    path = write_feed([_feature(f\"e{i}\", m, i) for i, m in enumerate(mags)])\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"summary\", path)\n    assert code == 0\n    header, row = _rows(out)\n    assert int(dict(zip(header, row))[\"events\"]) == len([m for m in mags if m is not None])\n\n\ndef test_summary_empty(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    path = write_feed([_feature(\"e0\", 5.0, 0)])\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"summary\", \"--min-mag\", \"9\", path)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = _rows(out)\n    assert len(rows) == 2\n    assert rows[1] == [\"0\", \"\", \"\", \"\", \"\", \"\", \"0\"]\n\n\ndef test_summary_failure_codes(tmp_path, cli_runner):\n    garbage = tmp_path / \"garbage.json\"\n    garbage.write_text(\"this is not json\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    missing = tmp_path / \"no-such-file.geojson\"\n\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"summary\", str(garbage))\n    assert code == 1 and out == \"\"\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"summary\", str(missing))\n    assert code == 1 and out == \"\"\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"summary\", \"--n\", \"3\", story: events per region derived from the place text, with the maximum magnitude.\"\"\"\n\nimport csv\nimport io\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom cli import reports\n\nHEADER = [\"region\", \"events\", \"max_mag\"]\n\n\ndef _feature(ident, mag, place, time_ms=1735706358208, tsunami=0):\n    return {\n        \"type\": \"Feature\",\n        \"properties\": {\"mag\": mag, \"place\": place, \"time\": time_ms, \"tsunami\": tsunami},\n        \"geometry\": {\"type\": \"Point\", \"coordinates\": [1.0, 2.0, 3.0]},\n        \"id\": ident,\n    }\n\n\ndef _rows(out):\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\n# ── Declared acceptance assertions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_regions_extract_and_order(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    pairs = [\n        (\"Zed\", 5.0), (\"Zed\", 5.6),\n        (\"alpha\", 5.1),\n        (\"Beta\", 5.2), (\"Beta\", 5.0),\n        (\"Gamma\", 5.3), (\"Gamma\", 5.9), (\"Gamma\", 5.1),\n        (\"Delta\", 5.4),\n    ]\n    features = [_feature(\"e\" + str(i), mag, \"12 km N of Town \" + str(i) + \", \" + region, 1735706358208 + i)\n                for i, (region, mag) in enumerate(pairs)]\n    expected = {}\n    for region, mag in pairs:\n        entry = expected.setdefault(region, [0, mag])\n        entry[0] += 1\n        entry[1] = max(entry[1], mag)\n    order = sorted(expected, key=lambda r: (-expected[r][0], r))\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"regions\", write_feed(features))\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = _rows(out)\n    assert rows[0] == HEADER\n    assert [r[0] for r in rows[1:]] == order\n    for r in rows[1:]:\n        assert int(r[1]) == expected[r[0]][0]\n        assert float(r[2]) == expected[r[0]][1]\n\n\ndef test_regions_place_rules(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    last_part = \"Country\"\n    multi_place = \"Near Town, Province, \" + last_part\n    plain_place = \"Mid-Atlantic Ridge\"\n    comma_no_space = \"A,B\"\n    places = [multi_place, plain_place, comma_no_space, None]\n    features = [_feature(\"e\" + str(i), 5.0, place, 1735706358208 + i) for i, place in enumerate(places)]\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"regions\", write_feed(features))\n    assert code == 0\n    names = {r[0] for r in _rows(out)[1:]}\n    assert names == {last_part, plain_place, comma_no_space, \"Unknown\"}\n\n\ndef test_regions_min_mag_and_empty(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    threshold = 5.4\n    pairs = [(\"Aland\", 5.0), (\"Aland\", 5.4), (\"Bland\", 6.0), (\"Cland\", None), (\"Dland\", 5.3)]\n    features = [_feature(\"e\" + str(i), mag, \"5 km S of T, \" + region, 1735706358208 + i)\n                for i, (region, mag) in enumerate(pairs)]\n    path = write_feed(features)\n    kept = [(r, m) for r, m in pairs if m is not None and m >= threshold]\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"regions\", \"--min-mag\", str(threshold), path)\n    code_none, out_none, _ = cli_runner(\"regions\", \"--min-mag\", \"9\", path)\n    assert code == 0 and code_none == 0\n    rows = _rows(out)\n    assert {r[0] for r in rows[1:]} == {r for r, _ in kept}\n    assert sum(int(r[1]) for r in rows[1:]) == len(kept)\n    assert _rows(out_none) == [HEADER]\n\n\ndef test_regions_failure_contract(tmp_path, cli_runner):\n    bad = tmp_path / \"bad.json\"\n    bad.write_text(\"this is not json\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"regions\", str(bad))\n    assert code == 1\n    assert out == \"\"\n    code2, out2, _ = cli_runner(\"regions\", \"--lat\", \"1\", str(bad))\n    assert code2 == 2\n    assert out2 == \"\"\n\n\n# ── Finer coverage ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    (\"place\", \"region\"),\n    [\n        (\"56 km SSE of La Libertad, El Salvador\", \"El Salvador\"),\n        (\"a, b, c\", \"c\"),\n        (\"Fiji region\", \"Fiji region\"),\n        (\"Tonga, \", \"\"),\n        (None, \"Unknown\"),\n    ],\n)\ndef test_region_of(place, region):\n    assert reports.region_of(place) == region\n\n\ndef test_regions_same_count_breaks_tie_by_code_point_order():\n    features = [_feature(\"a\", 5.0, \"x, b\"), _feature(\"b\", 5.0, \"x, B\")]\n    # \"B\" (0x42) sorts before \"b\" (0x62); both have one event so the order is by name alone.\n    from cli.feed import extract_events\n\n    rows = reports.compute_regions(extract_events(features))\n    assert [r[0] for r in rows[1:]] == [\"B\", \"b\"]\n\n\ndef test_regions_empty_input_is_header_only():\n    assert reports.compute_regions([]) == text, with the maximum magnitude.\"\"\"\n\nimport csv\nimport io\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom cli import reports\n\nHEADER = [\"region\", \"events\", \"max_mag\"]\n\n\ndef _feature(ident, mag, place, time_ms=1735706358208, tsunami=0):\n    return {\n        \"type\": \"Feature\",\n        \"properties\": {\"mag\": mag, \"place\": place, \"time\": time_ms, \"tsunami\": tsunami},\n        \"geometry\": {\"type\": \"Point\", \"coordinates\": [1.0, 2.0, 3.0]},\n        \"id\": ident,\n    }\n\n\ndef _rows(out):\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\n# ── Declared acceptance assertions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_regions_extract_and_order(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    pairs = [\n        (\"Zed\", 5.0), (\"Zed\", 5.6),\n        (\"alpha\", 5.1),\n        (\"Beta\", 5.2), (\"Beta\", 5.0),\n        (\"Gamma\", 5.3), (\"Gamma\", 5.9), (\"Gamma\", 5.1),\n        (\"Delta\", 5.4),\n    ]\n    features = [_feature(\"e\" + str(i), mag, \"12 km N of Town \" + str(i) + \", \" + region, 1735706358208 + i)\n                for i, (region, mag) in enumerate(pairs)]\n    expected = {}\n    for region, mag in pairs:\n        entry = expected.setdefault(region, [0, mag])\n        entry[0] += 1\n        entry[1] = max(entry[1], mag)\n    order = sorted(expected, key=lambda r: (-expected[r][0], r))\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"regions\", write_feed(features))\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = _rows(out)\n    assert rows[0] == HEADER\n    assert [r[0] for r in rows[1:]] == order\n    for r in rows[1:]:\n        assert int(r[1]) == expected[r[0]][0]\n        assert float(r[2]) == expected[r[0]][1]\n\n\ndef test_regions_place_rules(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    last_part = \"Country\"\n    multi_place = \"Near Town, Province, \" + last_part\n    plain_place = \"Mid-Atlantic Ridge\"\n    comma_no_space = \"A,B\"\n    places = [multi_place, plain_place, comma_no_space, None]\n    features = [_feature(\"e\" + str(i), 5.0, place, 1735706358208 + i) for i, place in enumerate(places)]\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"regions\", write_feed(features))\n    assert code == 0\n    names = {r[0] for r in _rows(out)[1:]}\n    assert names == {last_part, plain_place, comma_no_space, \"Unknown\"}\n\n\ndef test_regions_min_mag_and_empty(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    threshold = 5.4\n    pairs = [(\"Aland\", 5.0), (\"Aland\", 5.4), (\"Bland\", 6.0), (\"Cland\", None), (\"Dland\", 5.3)]\n    features = [_feature(\"e\" + str(i), mag, \"5 km S of T, \" + region, 1735706358208 + i)\n                for i, (region, mag) in enumerate(pairs)]\n    path = write_feed(features)\n    kept = [(r, m) for r, m in pairs if m is not None and m >= threshold]\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"regions\", \"--min-mag\", str(threshold), path)\n    code_none, out_none, _ = cli_runner(\"regions\", \"--min-mag\", \"9\", path)\n    assert code == 0 and code_none == 0\n    rows = _rows(out)\n    assert {r[0] for r in rows[1:]} == {r for r, _ in kept}\n    assert sum(int(r[1]) for r in rows[1:]) == len(kept)\n    assert _rows(out_none) == [HEADER]\n\n\ndef test_regions_failure_contract(tmp_path, cli_runner):\n    bad = tmp_path / \"bad.json\"\n    bad.write_text(\"this is not json\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"regions\", str(bad))\n    assert code == 1\n    assert out == \"\"\n    code2, out2, _ = cli_runner(\"regions\", \"--lat\", \"1\", str(bad))\n    assert code2 == 2\n    assert out2 == \"\"\n\n\n# ── Finer coverage Salvador\"),\n        (\"a, b, c\", \"c\"),\n        (\"Fiji region\", \"Fiji region\"),\n        (\"Tonga, \", \"\"),\n        (None, \"Unknown\"),\n    ],\n)\ndef test_region_of(place, region):\n    assert reports.region_of(place) == region\n\n\ndef test_regions_same_count_breaks_tie_by_code_point_order():\n    features = [_feature(\"a\", 5.0, \"x, b\"), _feature(\"b\", 5.0, \"x, B\")]\n    # \"B\" (0x42) sorts before \"b\" (0x62); both have one event so the order is by name alone.\n    from cli.feed import extract_events\n\n    rows = reports.compute_regions(extract_events(features))\n    assert [r[0] for r in rows[1:]] == [\"B\", \"b\"]\n\n\ndef test_regions_empty_input_is_header_only():\n    assert reports.compute_regions([]) == magnitude.\"\"\"\n\nimport csv\nimport io\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom cli import reports\nfrom cli.feed import extract_events\n\nHEADER = [\"region\", \"events\", \"max_mag\"]\n\n\ndef _feature(ident, mag, place, time_ms=1735706358208, tsunami=0):\n    return {\n        \"type\": \"Feature\",\n        \"properties\": {\"mag\": mag, \"place\": place, \"time\": time_ms, \"tsunami\": tsunami},\n        \"geometry\": {\"type\": \"Point\", \"coordinates\": [1.0, 2.0, 3.0]},\n        \"id\": ident,\n    }\n\n\ndef _rows(out):\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\n# ── Declared acceptance assertions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_regions_extract_and_order(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    pairs = [\n        (\"Zed\", 5.0), (\"Zed\", 5.6),\n        (\"alpha\", 5.1),\n        (\"Beta\", 5.2), (\"Beta\", 5.0),\n        (\"Gamma\", 5.3), (\"Gamma\", 5.9), (\"Gamma\", 5.1),\n        (\"Delta\", 5.4),\n    ]\n    features = [_feature(\"e\" + str(i), mag, \"12 km N of Town \" + str(i) + \", \" + region, 1735706358208 + i)\n                for i, (region, mag) in enumerate(pairs)]\n    expected = {}\n    for region, mag in pairs:\n        entry = expected.setdefault(region, [0, mag])\n        entry[0] += 1\n        entry[1] = max(entry[1], mag)\n    order = sorted(expected, key=lambda r: (-expected[r][0], r))\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"regions\", write_feed(features))\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = _rows(out)\n    assert rows[0] == HEADER\n    assert [r[0] for r in rows[1:]] == order\n    for r in rows[1:]:\n        assert int(r[1]) == expected[r[0]][0]\n        assert float(r[2]) == expected[r[0]][1]\n\n\ndef test_regions_place_rules(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    last_part = \"Country\"\n    multi_place = \"Near Town, Province, \" + last_part\n    plain_place = \"Mid-Atlantic Ridge\"\n    comma_no_space = \"A,B\"\n    places = [multi_place, plain_place, comma_no_space, None]\n    features = [_feature(\"e\" + str(i), 5.0, place, 1735706358208 + i) for i, place in enumerate(places)]\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"regions\", write_feed(features))\n    assert code == 0\n    names = {r[0] for r in _rows(out)[1:]}\n    assert names == {last_part, plain_place, comma_no_space, \"Unknown\"}\n\n\ndef test_regions_min_mag_and_empty(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    threshold = 5.4\n    pairs = [(\"Aland\", 5.0), (\"Aland\", 5.4), (\"Bland\", 6.0), (\"Cland\", None), (\"Dland\", 5.3)]\n    features = [_feature(\"e\" + str(i), mag, \"5 km S of T, \" + region, 1735706358208 + i)\n                for i, (region, mag) in enumerate(pairs)]\n    path = write_feed(features)\n    kept = [(r, m) for r, m in pairs if m is not None and m >= threshold]\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"regions\", \"--min-mag\", str(threshold), path)\n    code_none, out_none, _ = cli_runner(\"regions\", \"--min-mag\", \"9\", path)\n    assert code == 0 and code_none == 0\n    rows = _rows(out)\n    assert {r[0] assert reports.region_of(place) == region\n\n\ndef test_regions_same_count_breaks_tie_by_code_point_order():\n    features = [_feature(\"a\", 5.0, \"x, b\"), _feature(\"b\", 5.0, \"x, B\")]\n    # story: events per UTC date with the maximum magnitude, then a TOTAL row.\"\"\"\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\n\nfrom cli import reports\nfrom cli.feed import Event\n\nHEADER = [\"date\", \"events\", \"max_mag\"]\n\n\ndef _ms(day, hour, minute=0, second=0, milli=0):\n    moment = datetime(2025, 1, day, hour, minute, second, tzinfo=timezone.utc)\n    return int(moment.timestamp()) * 1000 + milli\n\n\ndef _feature(ident, mag, time_ms, place=\"P\"):\n    return {\n        \"type\": \"Feature\",\n        \"properties\": {\"mag\": mag, \"place\": place, \"time\": time_ms, \"tsunami\": 0},\n        \"geometry\": {\"type\": \"Point\", \"coordinates\": [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]},\n        \"id\": ident,\n    }\n\n\ndef _rows(out):\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\ndef _event(mag, time_ms):\n    return Event(id=\"x\", mag=mag, place=\"P\", time_ms=time_ms, tsunami=0, lon=0.0, lat=0.0, depth_km=1.0)\n\n\n# ── Declared acceptance assertions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_daily_groups_by_utc_date(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    specs = [\n        (5.0, _ms(3, 1)),\n        (6.1, _ms(1, 2)),\n        (5.4, _ms(1, 23, 59, 59, 999)),\n        (5.5, _ms(3, 12)),\n        (5.2, _ms(7, 0)),\n    ]\n    expected = {}\n    for mag, t in specs:\n        label = datetime.fromtimestamp(t // 1000, timezone.utc).strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n        entry = expected.setdefault(label, [0, mag])\n        entry[0] += 1\n        entry[1] = max(entry[1], mag)\n    path = write_feed([_feature(\"e\" + str(i), m, t) for i, (m, t) in enumerate(specs)])\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"daily\", path)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = _rows(out)\n    assert rows[0] == HEADER\n    body = rows[1:-1]\n    assert [r[0] for r in body] == sorted(expected)\n    for r in body:\n        assert int(r[1]) == expected[r[0]][0]\n        assert float(r[2]) == expected[r[0]][1]\n    total = rows[-1]\n    assert total[0] == \"TOTAL\"\n    assert int(total[1]) == len(specs)\n    assert float(total[2]) == max(m for m, _ in specs)\n\n\ndef test_daily_empty_report(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    path = write_feed([_feature(\"only\", 5.0, 1735706358208, place=\"X, Y\")])\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"daily\", \"--min-mag\", \"9\", path)\n    code2, out2, _ = cli_runner(\"daily\", write_feed([], name=\"empty.geojson\"))\n    assert code == 0 and code2 == 0\n    for text in (out, out2):\n        assert _rows(text) == [HEADER, [\"TOTAL\", \"0\", \"\"]]\n\n\ndef test_daily_min_mag_and_null_mag(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    threshold = 5.4\n    specs = [(5.0, _ms(1, 1)), (5.4, _ms(1, 2)), (6.0, _ms(2, 3)), (None, _ms(2, 4)), (5.3, _ms(4, 5))]\n    kept = [(m, t) for m, t in specs if m is not None and m >= threshold]\n    path = write_feed([_feature(\"e\" + str(i), m, t) for i, (m, t) in enumerate(specs)])\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"daily\", \"--min-mag\", str(threshold), path)\n    code_all, out_all, _ = cli_runner(\"daily\", path)\n    assert code == 0 and code_all == 0\n    rows = _rows(out)\n    assert int(rows[-1][1]) == len(kept)\n    assert float(rows[-1][2]) == max(m for m, _ in kept)\n    assert len(rows) - 2 == len({datetime.fromtimestamp(t // 1000, timezone.utc).date() for _, t in kept})\n    rows_all = _rows(out_all)\n    assert int(rows_all[-1][1]) == len([1 for m, _ in specs if m is not None])\n\n\ndef test_daily_failure_contract(tmp_path, cli_runner):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"daily\", str(tmp_path / \"absent.geojson\"))\n    assert code == 1\n    assert out == \"\"\n    present = tmp_path / \"x.geojson\"\n    present.write_text(\"{}\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    code2, out2, _ = cli_runner(\"daily\", \"--n\", \"3\", str(present))\n    assert code2 == 2\n    assert out2 == \"\"\n\n\n# ── Finer coverage ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_daily_date_boundary_uses_utc_not_local():\n    # 23:59:59.999 UTC on the 1st stays on the 1st, and 00:00:00.000 UTC on the 2nd starts the 2nd.\n    rows, _ = reports.compute_daily([_event(5.0, _ms(1, 23, 59, 59, 999)), _event(5.0, _ms(2, 0))])\n    assert [r[0] for r in rows] == [\"2025-01-01\", \"2025-01-02\"]\n\n\ndef test_daily_total_is_max_over_all_dates():\n    rows, total = reports.compute_daily([_event(5.0, _ms(1, 1)), _event(7.2, _ms(3, 1)), _event(6.0, _ms(3, 2))])\n    assert total == [\"TOTAL\", \"3\", \"7.2\"]\n    assert rows == [[\"2025-01-01\", \"1\", \"5.0\"], [\"2025-01-03\", \"2\", \"7.2\"]]\n\n\ndef test_daily_compute_empty_gives_zero_total():\n    assert reports.compute_daily([]) == ([], [\"TOTAL\", \"0\", back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"1bffa937-a35b-4dc8-9198-9ad88f4a474d","uuid":"1c050e07-d579-4bc4-91ba-d811a2bb4578","timestamp":"2026-10-25T01:27:28.055Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"create","filePath":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/Quakes/runs/20261025.010423/build/Quakes/tests/test_daily.py","content":"\"\"\"Daily-report story: events per UTC date with the maximum magnitude, then a TOTAL row.\"\"\"\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\n\nfrom cli import reports\nfrom cli.feed import Event\n\nHEADER = [\"date\", \"events\", \"max_mag\"]\n\n\ndef _ms(day, hour, minute=0, second=0, milli=0):\n    moment = datetime(2025, 1, day, hour, minute, second, tzinfo=timezone.utc)\n    return int(moment.timestamp()) * 1000 + milli\n\n\ndef _feature(ident, mag, time_ms, place=\"P\"):\n    return {\n        \"type\": \"Feature\",\n        \"properties\": {\"mag\": mag, \"place\": place, \"time\": time_ms, \"tsunami\": 0},\n        \"geometry\": {\"type\": \"Point\", \"coordinates\": [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]},\n        \"id\": ident,\n    }\n\n\ndef _rows(out):\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\ndef _event(mag, time_ms):\n    return Event(id=\"x\", mag=mag, place=\"P\", time_ms=time_ms, tsunami=0, lon=0.0, lat=0.0, depth_km=1.0)\n\n\n# ── Declared acceptance assertions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_daily_groups_by_utc_date(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    specs = [\n        (5.0, _ms(3, 1)),\n        (6.1, _ms(1, 2)),\n        (5.4, _ms(1, 23, 59, 59, 999)),\n        (5.5, _ms(3, 12)),\n        (5.2, _ms(7, 0)),\n    ]\n    expected = {}\n    for mag, t in specs:\n        label = datetime.fromtimestamp(t // 1000, timezone.utc).strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n        entry = expected.setdefault(label, [0, mag])\n        entry[0] += 1\n        entry[1] = max(entry[1], mag)\n    path = write_feed([_feature(\"e\" + str(i), m, t) for i, (m, t) in enumerate(specs)])\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"daily\", path)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = _rows(out)\n    assert rows[0] == HEADER\n    body = rows[1:-1]\n    assert [r[0] for r in body] == sorted(expected)\n    for r in body:\n        assert int(r[1]) == expected[r[0]][0]\n        assert float(r[2]) == expected[r[0]][1]\n    total = rows[-1]\n    assert total[0] == \"TOTAL\"\n    assert int(total[1]) == len(specs)\n    assert float(total[2]) == max(m for m, _ in specs)\n\n\ndef test_daily_empty_report(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    path = write_feed([_feature(\"only\", 5.0, 1735706358208, place=\"X, Y\")])\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"daily\", \"--min-mag\", \"9\", path)\n    code2, out2, _ = cli_runner(\"daily\", write_feed([], name=\"empty.geojson\"))\n    assert code == 0 and code2 == 0\n    for text in (out, out2):\n        assert _rows(text) == [HEADER, [\"TOTAL\", \"0\", \"\"]]\n\n\ndef test_daily_min_mag_and_null_mag(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    threshold = 5.4\n    specs = [(5.0, _ms(1, 1)), (5.4, _ms(1, 2)), (6.0, _ms(2, 3)), (None, _ms(2, 4)), (5.3, _ms(4, 5))]\n    kept = [(m, t) for m, t in specs if m is not None and m >= threshold]\n    path = write_feed([_feature(\"e\" + str(i), m, t) for i, (m, t) in enumerate(specs)])\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"daily\", \"--min-mag\", str(threshold), path)\n    code_all, out_all, _ = cli_runner(\"daily\", path)\n    assert code == 0 and code_all == 0\n    rows = _rows(out)\n    assert int(rows[-1][1]) == len(kept)\n    assert float(rows[-1][2]) == max(m for m, _ in kept)\n    assert len(rows) - 2 == len({datetime.fromtimestamp(t // 1000, timezone.utc).date() for _, t in kept})\n    rows_all = _rows(out_all)\n    assert int(rows_all[-1][1]) == len([1 for m, _ in specs if m is not None])\n\n\ndef test_daily_failure_contract(tmp_path, cli_runner):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"daily\", str(tmp_path / \"absent.geojson\"))\n    assert code == 1\n    assert out == \"\"\n    present = tmp_path / \"x.geojson\"\n    present.write_text(\"{}\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    code2, out2, _ = cli_runner(\"daily\", \"--n\", \"3\", str(present))\n    assert code2 == 2\n    assert out2 == \"\"\n\n\n# ── Finer coverage ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_daily_date_boundary_uses_utc_not_local():\n    # 23:59:59.999 UTC on the 1st stays on the 1st, and 00:00:00.000 UTC on the 2nd starts the 2nd.\n    rows, _ = reports.compute_daily([_event(5.0, _ms(1, 23, 59, 59, 999)), _event(5.0, _ms(2, 0))])\n    assert [r[0] for r in rows] == [\"2025-01-01\", \"2025-01-02\"]\n\n\ndef test_daily_total_is_max_over_all_dates():\n    rows, total = reports.compute_daily([_event(5.0, _ms(1, 1)), _event(7.2, _ms(3, 1)), _event(6.0, _ms(3, 2))])\n    assert total == [\"TOTAL\", \"3\", \"7.2\"]\n    assert rows == [[\"2025-01-01\", \"1\", \"5.0\"], [\"2025-01-03\", \"2\", \"7.2\"]]\n\n\ndef test_daily_compute_empty_gives_zero_total():\n    assert reports.compute_daily([]) == ([], [\"TOTAL\", \"0\", \"\"])\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01WsnPTm6t3kXU1UA1zi9qs9","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgN5xvxsLrvA5nufwZbwQ","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_019xf6Z1nqYfsX6is8JBMijB","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/Quakes/runs/20261025.010423/build/Quakes/tests/test_top.py","content":"\"\"\"Top-report story: the largest events by magnitude, time ascending on ties, cut to `--n` after filtering.\"\"\"\n\nimport csv\nimport datetime\nimport io\n\nfrom cli import reports\nfrom cli.feed import Event\n\nHEADER = [\"time\", \"mag\", \"depth_km\", \"place\", \"id\"]\nBASE = 1735689600000\n\n\ndef _feature(ident, mag, time_ms, *, place=\"P\", depth=0.0):\n    return {\n        \"type\": \"Feature\",\n        \"id\": ident,\n        \"properties\": {\"mag\": mag, \"place\": place, \"time\": time_ms, \"tsunami\": 0},\n        \"geometry\": {\"type\": \"Point\", \"coordinates\": [0.0, 0.0, depth]},\n    }\n\n\ndef _rows(out):\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\ndef _event(ident, mag, time_ms):\n    return Event(id=ident, mag=mag, place=\"P\", time_ms=time_ms, tsunami=0, lon=0.0, lat=0.0, depth_km=0.0)\n\n\n# ── Declared acceptance assertions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_top_order_and_default_n(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    # (id, mag, minutes offset); two pairs tie on magnitude with different times.\n    specs = [(\"a\", 5.0, 50), (\"b\", 6.0, 40), (\"c\", 6.0, 10), (\"d\", 5.5, 30), (\"e\", 5.1, 20),\n             (\"f\", 7.0, 60), (\"g\", 5.2, 70), (\"h\", 5.3, 80), (\"i\", 5.4, 90), (\"j\", 5.6, 15),\n             (\"k\", 5.7, 25), (\"l\", 5.8, 35)]\n    features = [_feature(s[0], s[1], BASE + s[2] * 60000, depth=12.0) for s in specs]\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"top\", write_feed(features))\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = _rows(out)\n    header, body = rows[0], rows[1:]\n    assert header == HEADER\n    ranked = sorted(specs, key=lambda s: (-s[1], s[2]))\n    default_n = 10\n    assert len(specs) > default_n\n    assert [r[4] for r in body] == [s[0] for s in ranked[:default_n]]\n    first = dict(zip(header, body[0]))\n    assert float(first[\"mag\"]) == ranked[0][1]\n    assert float(first[\"depth_km\"]) == 12.0\n    parsed = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(first[\"time\"])\n    assert int(parsed.timestamp() * 1000) == BASE + ranked[0][2] * 60000\n\n\ndef test_top_n_option(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    specs = [(\"a\", 5.0), (\"b\", 6.0), (\"c\", 7.1), (\"d\", 5.5), (\"e\", 6.2)]\n    features = [_feature(s[0], s[1], BASE + i * 1000, depth=5.0) for i, s in enumerate(specs)]\n    count = 3\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"top\", \"--n\", str(count), write_feed(features))\n    assert code == 0\n    body = _rows(out)[1:]\n    assert [r[4] for r in body] == [s[0] for s in sorted(specs, key=lambda s: -s[1])[:count]]\n\n\ndef test_top_min_mag_before_cut(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    specs = [(\"a\", 5.0), (\"b\", 5.1), (\"c\", 5.2), (\"d\", 6.0), (\"e\", 7.0)]\n    features = [_feature(s[0], s[1], BASE + i * 1000, depth=5.0) for i, s in enumerate(specs)]\n    threshold = 5.1\n    count = 4\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"top\", \"--min-mag\", str(threshold), \"--n\", str(count), write_feed(features))\n    assert code == 0\n    body = _rows(out)[1:]\n    kept = sorted([s for s in specs if s[1] >= threshold], key=lambda s: -s[1])\n    assert [r[4] for r in body] == [s[0] for s in kept[:count]]\n    assert all(float(r[1]) >= threshold for r in body)\n\n\ndef test_top_place_with_comma(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    place = \"56 km SSE of Some Town, Some Country\"\n    features = [_feature(\"c1\", 6.2, BASE, place=place, depth=46.0)]\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"top\", write_feed(features))\n    assert code == 0\n    body = _rows(out)[1:]\n    assert len(body) == 1\n    assert body[0][3] == place\n    assert body[0][4] == \"c1\"\n\n\ndef test_top_empty_result(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"top\", \"--min-mag\", \"9\", write_feed([_feature(\"e0\", 5.0, BASE, depth=1.0)]))\n    assert code == 0\n    assert _rows(out) == [HEADER]\n\n\ndef test_top_usage_errors(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    path = write_feed([_feature(\"e0\", 5.0, BASE, depth=1.0)])\n    for args in ((\"top\", \"--n\", \"0\", path),\n                 (\"top\", \"--n\", \"-2\", path),\n                 (\"top\", \"--n\", \"many\", path),\n                 (\"top\", \"--lat\", \"1\", path),\n                 (\"top\",)):\n        code, out, _ = cli_runner(*args)\n        assert code == 2, args\n        assert out == \"\", args\n\n\n# ── Finer coverage ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_top_ties_on_mag_and_time_keep_feed_order():\n    events = [_event(\"first\", 6.0, BASE), _event(\"second\", 6.0, BASE)]\n    rows = reports.compute_top(events, 2)\n    assert [r[4] for r in rows[1:]] == [\"first\", \"second\"]\n\n\ndef test_top_n_larger_than_events_returns_all():\n    rows = reports.compute_top([_event(\"a\", 5.0, BASE)], 50)\n    assert len(rows) == 2\n\n\ndef test_top_null_place_is_empty_field():\n    event = Event(id=\"z\", mag=5.0, place=None, time_ms=BASE, tsunami=0, lon=0.0, lat=0.0, depth_km=1.0)\n    rows = reports.compute_top([event], 1)\n    assert rows[1][3] == story: the largest events by magnitude, time ascending on ties, cut to `--n` after filtering.\"\"\"\n\nimport csv\nimport datetime\nimport io\n\nfrom cli import reports\nfrom cli.feed import Event\n\nHEADER = [\"time\", \"mag\", \"depth_km\", \"place\", \"id\"]\nBASE = 1735689600000\n\n\ndef _feature(ident, mag, time_ms, *, place=\"P\", depth=0.0):\n    return {\n        \"type\": \"Feature\",\n        \"id\": ident,\n        \"properties\": {\"mag\": mag, \"place\": place, \"time\": time_ms, \"tsunami\": 0},\n        \"geometry\": {\"type\": \"Point\", \"coordinates\": [0.0, 0.0, depth]},\n    }\n\n\ndef _rows(out):\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\ndef _event(ident, mag, time_ms):\n    return Event(id=ident, mag=mag, place=\"P\", time_ms=time_ms, tsunami=0, lon=0.0, lat=0.0, depth_km=0.0)\n\n\n# ── Declared acceptance assertions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_top_order_and_default_n(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    # (id, mag, minutes offset); two pairs tie on magnitude with different times.\n    specs = [(\"a\", 5.0, 50), (\"b\", 6.0, 40), (\"c\", 6.0, 10), (\"d\", 5.5, 30), (\"e\", 5.1, 20),\n             (\"f\", 7.0, 60), (\"g\", 5.2, 70), (\"h\", 5.3, 80), (\"i\", 5.4, 90), (\"j\", 5.6, 15),\n             (\"k\", 5.7, 25), (\"l\", 5.8, 35)]\n    features = [_feature(s[0], s[1], BASE + s[2] * 60000, depth=12.0) for s in specs]\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"top\", write_feed(features))\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = _rows(out)\n    header, body = rows[0], rows[1:]\n    assert header == HEADER\n    ranked = sorted(specs, key=lambda s: (-s[1], s[2]))\n    default_n = 10\n    assert len(specs) > default_n\n    assert [r[4] for r in body] == [s[0] for s in ranked[:default_n]]\n    first = dict(zip(header, body[0]))\n    assert float(first[\"mag\"]) == ranked[0][1]\n    assert float(first[\"depth_km\"]) == 12.0\n    parsed = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(first[\"time\"])\n    assert int(parsed.timestamp() * 1000) == BASE + ranked[0][2] * 60000\n\n\ndef test_top_n_option(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    specs = [(\"a\", 5.0), (\"b\", 6.0), (\"c\", 7.1), (\"d\", 5.5), (\"e\", 6.2)]\n    features = [_feature(s[0], s[1], BASE + i * 1000, depth=5.0) for i, s in enumerate(specs)]\n    count = 3\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"top\", \"--n\", str(count), write_feed(features))\n    assert code == 0\n    body = _rows(out)[1:]\n    assert [r[4] for r in body] == [s[0] for s in sorted(specs, key=lambda s: -s[1])[:count]]\n\n\ndef test_top_min_mag_before_cut(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    specs = [(\"a\", 5.0), (\"b\", 5.1), (\"c\", 5.2), (\"d\", 6.0), (\"e\", 7.0)]\n    features = [_feature(s[0], s[1], BASE + i * 1000, depth=5.0) for i, s in enumerate(specs)]\n    threshold = 5.1\n    count = 4\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"top\", \"--min-mag\", str(threshold), \"--n\", str(count), write_feed(features))\n    assert code == 0\n    body = _rows(out)[1:]\n    kept = sorted([s for s in specs if s[1] >= threshold], key=lambda s: -s[1])\n    assert [r[4] for r in body] == [s[0] for s in kept[:count]]\n    assert all(float(r[1]) >= threshold for r in body)\n\n\ndef test_top_place_with_comma(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    place = \"56 km SSE of Some Town, Some Country\"\n    features = [_feature(\"c1\", 6.2, BASE, place=place, depth=46.0)]\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"top\", write_feed(features))\n    assert code == 0\n    body = _rows(out)[1:]\n    assert len(body) == 1\n    assert body[0][3] == place\n    assert body[0][4] == \"c1\"\n\n\ndef test_top_empty_result(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"top\", \"--min-mag\", \"9\", write_feed([_feature(\"e0\", 5.0, BASE, depth=1.0)]))\n    assert code == 0\n    assert _rows(out) == [HEADER]\n\n\ndef test_top_usage_errors(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    path = write_feed([_feature(\"e0\", 5.0, BASE, depth=1.0)])\n    for args in ((\"top\", \"--n\", \"0\", path),\n                 (\"top\", \"--n\", \"-2\", path),\n                 (\"top\", \"--n\", \"many\", path),\n                 (\"top\", \"--lat\", \"1\", path),\n                 (\"top\",)):\n        code, out, _ = cli_runner(*args)\n        assert code == 2, args\n        assert out == \"\", args\n\n\n# ── Finer coverage ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_top_ties_on_mag_and_time_keep_feed_order():\n    events = [_event(\"first\", 6.0, BASE), _event(\"second\", 6.0, BASE)]\n    rows = reports.compute_top(events, 2)\n    assert [r[4] for r in rows[1:]] == [\"first\", \"second\"]\n\n\ndef test_top_n_larger_than_events_returns_all():\n    rows = reports.compute_top([_event(\"a\", 5.0, BASE)], 50)\n    assert len(rows) == 2\n\n\ndef test_top_null_place_is_empty_field():\n    event = Event(id=\"z\", mag=5.0, place=None, time_ms=BASE, tsunami=0, lon=0.0, lat=0.0, depth_km=1.0)\n    rows = reports.compute_top([event], 1)\n    assert rows[1][3] == \"\"\n"}}}

assert query[\"endtime\"] == [end]\n    assert query[\"minmagnitude\"] == [\"2.5\"]\n    assert query[\"orderby\"] == [\"time-asc\"]\n\n\ndef test_fetch_min_mag_passthrough(tmp_path, cli_runner):\n story: events within a haversine great-circle distance of a point, nearest first.\"\"\"\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport json\nimport math\nimport os\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom cli import reports\nfrom cli.feed import Event\n\nHEADER = [\"distance_km\", \"time\", \"mag\", \"place\", \"id\"]\n\n\ndef _hav(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):\n    \"\"\"Independent haversine on a 6371.0 km sphere, written separately from the product code.\"\"\"\n    p1, p2 = math.radians(lat1), math.radians(lat2)\n    dphi = p2 - p1\n    dlam = math.radians(lon2 - lon1)\n    h = math.sin(dphi / 2) ** 2 + math.cos(p1) * math.cos(p2) * math.sin(dlam / 2) ** 2\n    return 2 * 6371.0 * math.asin(math.sqrt(h))\n\n\ndef _feature(ident, mag, time_ms, lon, lat, place=\"P\"):\n    return {\n        \"type\": \"Feature\",\n        \"properties\": {\"mag\": mag, \"place\": place, \"time\": time_ms, \"tsunami\": 0},\n        \"geometry\": {\"type\": \"Point\", \"coordinates\": [lon, lat, 10.0]},\n        \"id\": ident,\n    }\n\n\ndef _rows(out):\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\ndef _event(ident, lat, lon, time_ms=1736200000000, mag=5.0):\n    return Event(id=ident, mag=mag, place=\"P\", time_ms=time_ms, tsunami=0, lon=lon, lat=lat, depth_km=1.0)\n\n\n# ── Declared acceptance assertions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_near_haversine_distance_and_radius(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    origin = (27.72, 85.32)\n    points = [\n        (\"far\", 35.68, 139.69),\n        (\"mid\", 28.60, 87.37),\n        (\"near1\", 28.80, 87.13),\n        (\"near2\", 28.50, 87.35),\n    ]\n    features = [_feature(name, 5.0 + i / 10, 1736200000000 + i * 1000, lon, lat, place=\"Place \" + name)\n                for i, (name, lat, lon) in enumerate(points)]\n    dist = {name: _hav(origin[0], origin[1], lat, lon) for name, lat, lon in points}\n    radius = round(sorted(dist.values())[2] + 1.0, 1)\n    inside = sorted([n for n in dist if dist[n] <= radius], key=lambda n: dist[n])\n    assert 0 < len(inside) < len(points)\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\n        \"near\", \"--lat\", str(origin[0]), \"--lon\", str(origin[1]), \"--radius\", str(radius), write_feed(features)\n    )\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = _rows(out)\n    assert rows[0] == HEADER\n    assert [r[4] for r in rows[1:]] == inside\n    for r in rows[1:]:\n        assert abs(float(r[0]) - dist[r[4]]) <= 0.051\n\n\ndef test_near_ordering_ties_and_quoting(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    place = \"10 km N of Somewhere, Country\"\n    times = [1736200003000, 1736200001000, 1736200002000]\n    features = [_feature(\"t\" + str(i), 5.0, t, 10.0, 10.0, place=place) for i, t in enumerate(times)]\n    expected_ids = [\"t\" + str(i) for i in sorted(range(len(times)), key=lambda i: times[i])]\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"near\", \"--lat\", \"10\", \"--lon\", \"10.5\", \"--radius\", \"500\", write_feed(features))\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = _rows(out)\n    assert [r[4] for r in rows[1:]] == expected_ids\n    assert all(r[3] == place for r in rows[1:])\n\n\ndef test_near_min_mag_null_mag_and_empty(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    threshold = 5.3\n    mags = [5.0, 5.3, 6.0, None]\n    features = [_feature(\"m\" + str(i), m, 1736200000000 + i, 20.0, 20.0, place=\"P\" + str(i))\n                for i, m in enumerate(mags)]\n    path = write_feed(features)\n    kept = [\"m\" + str(i) for i, m in enumerate(mags) if m is not None and m >= threshold]\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"near\", \"--lat\", \"20\", \"--lon\", \"20\", \"--radius\", \"50\", \"--min-mag\", str(threshold), path)\n    code_e, out_e, _ = cli_runner(\"near\", \"--lat\", \"0\", \"--lon\", \"0\", \"--radius\", \"100\", path)\n    assert code == 0 and code_e == 0\n    rows = _rows(out)\n    assert sorted(r[4] for r in rows[1:]) == sorted(kept)\n    assert _rows(out_e) == [HEADER]\n\n\ndef test_near_usage_errors(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    path = write_feed([])\n    cases = [\n        (\"near\", \"--lat\", \"10\", \"--lon\", \"10\", path),\n        (\"near\", \"--lat\", \"10\", \"--radius\", \"5\", path),\n        (\"near\", \"--lon\", \"10\", \"--radius\", \"5\", path),\n        (\"near\", \"--lat\", \"95\", \"--lon\", \"0\", \"--radius\", \"10\", path),\n        (\"near\", \"--lat\", \"0\", \"--lon\", \"181\", \"--radius\", \"10\", path),\n        (\"near\", \"--lat\", \"0\", \"--lon\", \"0\", \"--radius\", \"0\", path),\n        (\"near\", \"--lat\", \"x\", \"--lon\", \"0\", \"--radius\", \"5\", path),\n        (\"near\", \"--lat\", \"0\", \"--lon\", \"0\", \"--radius\", \"5\", \"--n\", \"2\", path),\n    ]\n    for args in cases:\n        code, out, _ = cli_runner(*args)\n        assert code == 2, args\n        assert out == \"\", args\n\n\ndef test_near_unreadable_file(tmp_path, cli_runner):\n    missing = os.path.join(tmp_path, \"absent.geojson\")\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"near\", \"--lat\", \"1\", \"--lon\", \"1\", \"--radius\", \"5\", missing)\n    assert code == 1\n    assert out == \"\"\n\n\n# ── Finer coverage ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_haversine_one_degree_of_equator_longitude():\n    # One degree of longitude on the equator is 2 * pi * 6371 / 360 kilometres.\n    expected = 2 * math.pi * 6371.0 / 360\n    assert reports.haversine_km(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0) == pytest.approx(expected, rel=1e-12)\n\n\ndef test_haversine_zero_for_same_point():\n    assert reports.haversine_km(27.72, 85.32, 27.72, 85.32) == 0.0\n\n\ndef test_haversine_antipodal_points_do_not_raise():\n    # Rounding can push sqrt(h) a hair above 1; the function must clamp rather than fail.\n    assert reports.haversine_km(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 180.0) == pytest.approx(math.pi * 6371.0)\n\n\ndef test_near_radius_boundary_is_inclusive(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    distance = reports.haversine_km(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0)\n    features = [_feature(\"edge\", 5.0, 1736200000000, 1.0, 0.0)]\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"near\", \"--lat\", \"0\", \"--lon\", \"0\", \"--radius\", repr(distance), write_feed(features))\n    assert code == 0\n    assert [r[4] for r in _rows(out)[1:]] == [\"edge\"]\n\n\ndef test_near_compute_orders_by_distance_then_time():\n    events = [_event(\"far\", 0.0, 2.0), _event(\"late\", 0.0, 1.0, time_ms=2000), _event(\"early\", 0.0, 1.0, time_ms=1000)]\n    rows = reports.compute_near(events, 0.0, 0.0, 500.0)\n    assert [r[4] for r in rows[1:]] == [\"early\", \"late\", \"far\"]\n\n\ndef test_near_null_place_is_empty_field():\n    event = Event(id=\"z\", mag=5.0, place=None, time_ms=1736200000000, tsunami=0, lon=0.0, lat=0.0, depth_km=1.0)\n    rows = reports.compute_near([event], 0.0, 0.0, 1.0)\n    assert rows[1][3] == 0.0\n\n\ndef test_haversine_antipodal_points_do_not_raise():\n    # Rounding can push sqrt(h) a hair above 1; the function must clamp rather than fail.\n    assert reports.haversine_km(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 180.0) == pytest.approx(math.pi * 6371.0)\n\n\ndef test_near_radius_boundary_is_inclusive(write_feed, cli_runner):\n    distance = reports.haversine_km(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0)\n    features = [_feature(\"edge\", 5.0, 1736200000000, 1.0, 0.0)]\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"near\", \"--lat\", \"0\", \"--lon\", \"0\", \"--radius\", repr(distance), write_feed(features))\n    assert code == 0\n    assert [r[4] for r in _rows(out)[1:]] == [\"edge\"]\n\n\ndef test_near_compute_orders_by_distance_then_time():\n    events = [_event(\"far\", 0.0, 2.0), _event(\"late\", 0.0, 1.0, time_ms=2000), _event(\"early\", 0.0, 1.0, time_ms=1000)]\n    rows = reports.compute_near(events, 0.0, 0.0, 500.0)\n    assert [r[4] for r in rows[1:]] == [\"early\", \"late\", \"far\"]\n\n\ndef test_near_null_place_is_empty_field():\n    event = Event(id=\"z\", mag=5.0, place=None, time_ms=1736200000000, tsunami=0, lon=0.0, lat=0.0, depth_km=1.0)\n    rows = reports.compute_near([event], 0.0, 0.0, 1.0)\n    assert rows[1][3] == \"\"\n"}}}
